## September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 535)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1, 1939** across historic emergency addresses and live field reporting at the onset of World War II, President Franklin D. Roosevelt's emergency press address on American neutrality, former President Herbert Hoover on NBC, Polskie Radio Warsaw's emergency military mobilization broadcast, Lionel Marson and Alvar Liddell reporting for the BBC Home Service, and S.J. de Lotbinière live on the platform at London Waterloo Station (1939):
